# Loclume

> Loclume is a modern inventory-verification SaaS by WeIntensify B.V. (Alkmaar, the Netherlands). Operators scan a shelf and its products with a barcode scanner, an Android scanner terminal or a phone camera; Loclume compares the physical count with Stockitup (the Dutch e-commerce inventory system) and lets an authorised user resolve differences safely. It complements Stockitup, it does not replace it.

## Key facts

- Product: shelf counting, bulk shelf moves, product lookup, offline counting, roles and permissions, full audit trail, multi-tenant.
- Works with: Stockitup (stockitup.nl) as the system of record; approved corrections are written back.
- Hardware: phone camera, Android scanner terminals, existing HID/Bluetooth/USB scanners (keyboard wedge).
- Pricing: €30 per month per company, excl. VAT, cancel monthly.
- Platforms: Web, Android, iOS (app launching soon).
- Languages: Dutch (primary), English.
- Contact: info@loclume.com
- Company: WeIntensify B.V., Kanaalkade 57, 1811 LS Alkmaar, the Netherlands.
